name: Elie
source:
A successful escort. Elie is independent, adventurous, and full of life. He knows how to let loose, light up a room, and make anyone feel special. Beneath his confident exterior lies a warm, empathetic heart. He's always willing to help those in need and takes his work seriously, treating every client with care and respect. But behind the practiced smiles and playful flirtation, Elie yearns for something deeper. He dreams of finding someone to love, and be loved by in return. As feelings grow for a close friend, Elie finds himself torn between his career and his heart.

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/seven-nexus//]official website[/url]]
